items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The interviewee only responds 'They left' to the interviewer's questions about Jeannette's background; no personal interaction or relationship is described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: It was the same was like the mother hall but you were good at going both sides. Yeah.
I saw I went there once at church. Jeannette you know. Yeah. Your sister-in-law took me there one time. 1943. But the bandstand wasn't there anymore then. It was all changed. You took it down.
